column4: The fate of this world was never already written.
I have watched colder centuries than yours end over a single cup of tea.
这个世界的命运，还没有定数。
我说话很慢，但你最好听完。
コノ セカイ ノ ウンメイ ワ、マダ カタラレテ モ イナイ ホノ イチ ペン ニ スギナイ。
You kept me waiting. That was your first mistake.
I do not repeat myself. I repeat *you*, badly, for comic effect.
